item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Secretary of Defense, acting through the Committee, to design and establish an administrative program; no legal entitlement or specified later legal consequence is imposed.","evidence":"The Secretary of Defense shall, through the Economic Adjustment Committee, design and establish a Defense Economic Adjustment Program."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The program and its officials are assigned ongoing analytical, coordinating, assistance, and internal organizational functions, without presently changing legal rights or mandating a specified legally consequential agency outcome.","evidence":"The Defense Economic Adjustment Program shall assist in the alleviation of serious community socioeconomic effects"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"Defense and Committee officials must provide administrative support, coordinate the program, develop notification procedures, and report; these are internal management and reporting duties rather than legal consequences.","evidence":"shall provide all necessary policy and administrative support for the Committee"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"Agency heads and agencies receive liaison, coordination, support, and priority-consideration duties, while the remaining clauses provide internal construction, review, effectiveness, and supersession housekeeping; none grants assistance or property or otherwise dictates a legally consequential outcome.","evidence":"Afford priority consideration to requests from Defense-affected communities"}]}
